titulo: Two Carlton players treated in hospital after off-season night out
cuerpo: Club issues brief statement about Lachie Cowan and Will Hayward, saying latter suffered minor cut to head after a fall An off-season night out for Carlton football club teammates ended with two players admitted to hospital for treatment on Sunday morning, in what the club says are “separate circumstances”. The club released a statement on Sunday confirming that AFL players Lachie Cowan, 21, and Will Hayward, 27, had been treated and discharged, after reports in several media outlets about the aftermath of an off-season night out. Guardian Australia understands both players were both part of a larger group that had been socialising on Saturday evening. Continue reading...
